speaker: Unknown
en: Software testing is widely understood as essential to building reliable systems, and it's one of the hardest things to get right.
zh: 软件测试被广泛认为是构建可靠系统的关键，也是最难做对的事情之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: A fundamental issue is that tests are good at confirming the behavior a team expects, but the most damaging failures tend to hide in the edge cases no one thought to check during development.
zh: 一个根本问题在于，测试擅长确认团队预期的行为，但最具破坏性的故障往往隐藏在开发过程中没人想到要去检查的边缘情况里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Those blind spots are only growing as AI produces more code that no human has closely reviewed.
zh: 随着 AI 产出越来越多没有经过人类仔细审查的代码，这些盲区只会不断扩大。

speaker: Unknown
en: Antithesis is a software verification company built around an approach called deterministic simulation testing.
zh: Antithesis 是一家软件验证公司，围绕一种叫做确定性仿真测试的方法而构建。

speaker: Unknown
en: The platform runs a customer software in a fully controlled environment, exploring thousands of different paths through it at runtime.
zh: 该平台在完全受控的环境中运行客户软件，在运行时探索其中成千上万条不同的路径。

speaker: Unknown
en: Crucially, the paths aren't pre-specified and they're not merely the expected cases.
zh: 至关重要的是，这些路径不是预先指定的，也不仅仅是那些预期的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: In this way, it can surface rare, damaging bugs that normal testing would never catch.
zh: 通过这种方式，它能够暴露出正常测试永远不会捕捉到的罕见且具破坏性的 bug。

speaker: Unknown
en: Carl Svera is on the red team at Antithesis, and he also leads much of the company's AI strategy.
zh: Carl Svera 在 Antithesis 的红团队工作，他还领导着公司的很多 AI 战略。

speaker: Unknown
en: In this episode, Carl joins Sean Falconer to discuss the Antithesis approach to software verification, why reliability tooling has been chronically underinvested, what makes stateful and distributed systems so hard to test, how deterministic simulation testing works under the hood, and much more.

speaker: Unknown

en: Almost the entire piece of software is highly stateful.

en: It's highly dependent on the history of inputs up to this point across the entire software and also all the future inputs.
